publishedSpecifications.worksheet: Official PDF unnumbered artist roster; no card numbers inferred

sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 704 numbered subject rows across 30 sections and 116 unnumbered sketch artists reconciled against physical cells. The three base tiers contain 100 subject rows but 98 distinct numeric identities: printed 34/034 and 41/041 repeat, while numeric 36 and 42 are absent. Preserve leading zeros and the published 19/46 forms. Blacklight, Negative Zone and Tribute each retain all 100 printed codes. Actor/character, artist and comic-issue cells remain separate unlabelled source fields. Repeated dual/triple/quad signer numbers and the missing FS-10 are retained. All 158 odds categories retain their complete wrapped names and literal Hobby ratios from ruled cells. The odds sheet names Hobby but does not state a ratio unit; no per-pack rate or probability is inferred. Only Tribute to Finest 96 /96 and Fantastic Creators 1/1 have guide-confirmed numbering; other parallel limits and a calendar release date remain unverified.

parallelSpecifications.name: Tribute to Finest '96
parallelSpecifications.qualification: Tribute base variation only; no limits for its other named Refractors are inferred.

parallelSpecifications.name: Cut-signature relics
parallelSpecifications.qualification: The guide names Jack Kirby and Stan Lee cut-signature relics; no other family is assigned this limit.
